projects.challenge: Finity needed to look credible in a crowded fintech market from day one — a brand flexible enough for a payments product, and an app that makes flexible billing feel simple, not confusing.
projects.name: Finity Pay As You Go
projects.about: Finity is a pay-as-you-go fintech that lets people pay only for what they actually use. We gave it a brand and an app design ready to earn trust from the first screen.
projects.solution: We built the full identity — logomark, type, and a purple-and-lime system that stands out in fintech — then designed the app around one idea: you always know what you are paying for. Delivered in two weeks.

projects.challenge: Alfred was raising and partnering with banks while still looking like a prototype. It needed a brand and product design that could convince regulators, banks, and everyday users at the same time.
projects.name: Alfred
projects.about: Alfred is a LATAM fintech for fast, simple money movement. We designed the brand, the website, and the app, and developed the site — the platform now moves 12K transactions a month.
projects.scope: Brand, web & app design, web development
projects.solution: A clean wordmark with a directional arrow, a dark confident visual system, and web + app interfaces designed for trust and speed. The result backed a $1M investment from Stellar and +5 bank partnerships across LATAM.

projects.challenge: Sports-adjacent eagle logos are everywhere — most look generic. Eagle Partners needed a mark that felt bold and established without falling into cliché.
projects.name: Eagle
projects.about: Eagle Partners needed an identity with the authority its name promises. We designed the full brand: mark, typography, and color system.
projects.solution: We integrated the eagle head into the wordmark itself — the G becomes the bird — over a deep navy system with a gold-to-orange gradient. One asset, instantly recognizable at any size.

projects.challenge: DAWN had a complex, technical product and needed one coherent identity across five different surfaces — marketing site, app, dashboard, and extension — clear enough for non-technical users to join.
projects.name: DAWN Internet
projects.about: DAWN is a decentralized internet provider. We designed the brand and every surface of the product — website, app, dashboard, and Chrome extension — and developed the web.
projects.scope: Brand, web, Chrome extension, app, dashboard & web development
projects.solution: A signal-wave mark and a dark, focused system applied consistently across web, app, dashboard, and extension. The unified experience helped DAWN raise over $1M and grow to 1M users.
